request: Regenerate love-1 and desire-1 with white heart pupils

approval.message: This Faruzan neutral is much better, go for it!

tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body love-1 visual-novel sprite of Faruzan. Use the supplied approved neutral as the sole image reference. Preserve her identity, skin tone, hair, costume, colours, accessories and rendering. Keep her at least as petite as the neutral with the same compact general body proportions; do not lengthen torso or legs. Give her a warm affectionate smile and open eyes, one hand over her heart; allow a genuinely different pose appropriate to the emotion. Both eyes visibly open; preserve the original irises and their colour and detail, with filled white heart-shaped pupils inside the irises, not floating symbols or catchlights. Her skirt and fabric panels hang naturally downward at rest; no windblown fabric. Keep gestures simple, hands near the torso with coherent palms and naturally grouped fingers, exactly two legs and feet, with feet separated or slightly staggered. Show the entire silhouette including hair, accessories and shoes, with roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding. Genuinely transparent background. No scenery, text, labels, UI, props, companions, detached effects, watermark or ground shadow.
